versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the odata-query skill for discovering and querying OData v4.0/v4.01 services.
- Supports inspection of service documents, metadata, and translating questions into OData URLs.
- Handles entity retrieval, filtering, selecting, sorting, counting, pagination, and expansion, following OData standards.
- Enforces strict read-only access; create, update, delete, and other mutating actions are not supported.
- Provides guidance for secure endpoint and credential management, metadata-driven validation, and robust error diagnosis.
